summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SENSITIVE_FALL (type 8) integration. All features tested successfully. Backend POST /api/create-sensitive-fall-event creates events correctly, GET /api/events returns SENSITIVE_FALL events with proper fields (type, fall_status, confidence_level, suspected_events_counter, location). Frontend displays French labels correctly: 'Chute suspecte' for SENSITIVE_FALL, 'Chute' for FALL.
